correctness.rationale: Exact normalized Mellin moments give e_n=(n+1)^((α+1)/2)z^n; pointwise δ-separation splits the measure into E where φ is small and F where ψ is small. Restricting Q_N each factor is Hilbert–Schmidt with squared norm ≤Σ_(n≥N)(n+1)^(α+1)r^(2n). Hence ||Q_N T Q_N|| ≤(||Cφ||+||Cψ||)B_N; T−Q_NTQ_N has rank ≤2N, establishing s_(2N+1) bound. Monotonicity gives limsup s_n^(1/n)≤√δ and all S_p, p>0. For linear fractions δ<1 iff contacts disjoint by compactness of closed disk. Conversely Clifford–Zheng Theorem 1.3 excludes shared contact for α>−1, and Leng–Zhao Theorem 3.4(b) excludes it for Hardy α=−1. The analytic proof handles infinite-dimensional norms; finite exact tests are supplementary.

value.rationale: The motivating 2026 characterization explicitly excludes Bergman p≤1 for the cross-adjoint operator, with only separate partial trace-class sufficient criteria. The exact rank-2N localization estimate gives a uniform exponentially decaying singular-value envelope and membership for all 0<p<1, plus a family of weighted Hilbert-space variants and a noncompact-factor infinite-rank example. This is a natural quantitative operator-ideal gap rather than a parameter substitution or recertification of known compactness.
